title: MPA Declaration Bundle
description: v0.4 of the auditor-facing contract. Two additions over v0.3: (1) Lag/display separation -- observable.data[].tau is the framework canonical lag (= sample.dt); observable.data[].display_tau is the substrate-community display-time field (= sample.t for glass-CK convention). The model evaluates at tau (lag); viewers render the x-axis from display_tau when present, falling back to tau. (2) fit_provenance.fitted_params declares the optional substrate-thermodynamic 6-vector (q_EA, tau_alpha, beta_KWW, tau_beta, X), the glass apparatus per RULES §15 (substrate's deviation from cdv1 leading-order chit). v0.3 readers can ignore both (additionalProperties=true on the relevant sub-objects).
_v0_3_diff: Compared to v0.3: (a) schema const bumped; (b) observable.data[] semantics: tau is lag (was sample-time), new optional display_tau carries sample-time; (c) fitted_params gains documented q_EA, tau_alpha, beta_KWW, tau_beta, X, T fields (all optional, not required); (d) observable.metadata gains optional operating_point_T, operating_point_h_field, operating_point_p_base, tau_anchoring fields. v0.3 readers see additionalProperties=true on observable, observable.data items, fitted_params, observable.metadata, so they parse v0.4 without errors -- but the tau values shift from sample-time to lag, so any downstream fit results recompute.
_v0_2_diff: Compared to v0.2: (a) schema const bumped; (b) audit_delta gains optional fit_diagnostics, diagnostic_percentiles, cross_path_disagreement. No required-field changes. Backward-readable: v0.2 readers see additionalProperties=true on audit_delta.
_extension_note: Closed at top level on purpose: the declaration bundle is a versioned exchange contract. v0.1 -> v0.2 makes fit_provenance required (was optional) and tightens its inner shape. Open-typed extension still lives in declaration_trail entries and metadata blocks.
_v0_1_diff: Compared to v0.1: (a) schema const bumped; (b) fit_provenance moved from optional to required, inner shape tightened; (c) inversion_provenance + inversion_validation added as optional fit_provenance sub-objects. Everything else unchanged.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version. Auditor switches import logic on this.

tier.description: Curator-path bundles are 'curated' (committed seed-corpus); researcher-path bundles are 'user' (declaration-driven, validation-status fenced).

signature.description: v0.2 keeps v0.1's signing posture unchanged (manifest_hash + signed_by sufficient; algorithm 'none' permitted). The Ed25519/JCS/DSSE-around-in-toto bump is a parallel signing track per docs/ROADMAP.md §v0.2 signing, not gated on this schema bump.

manifest_hash.description: Hex digest of the canonicalized bundle body (everything except this signature object).

signed_by.description: Curator name (curated tier) or researcher identifier / ORCID (user tier).

observable.description: Canonical (tau, C, chi) gFDR observable. Substrate-native rows. v0.3+ may add observable.canonical_data (per foundational §Q-scale-management-as-compute-scaffolding) once scale-solver v2 lands curve-level operations; not in v0.2.

fit_provenance.description: Curator-time inversion fit + predicted locus + audit delta. Required in v0.2 (was optional in v0.1). Viewers consume; they do not refit (per H:/mpa-central/SUITE_BLOCK_IN.md). Optional inversion_provenance + inversion_validation sub-objects carry the mpa-scale-solver v1 stamps when the curator runs the validation pass.

fitted_params.description: Canonical-parameter estimate at the operating point. chit and gamma_AB are the cdv1 leading-order (required). The substrate-thermodynamic 6-vector (q_EA, tau_alpha, beta_KWW, tau_beta, X) is optional in v0.4 -- carried when the inversion supports the extended forward model (RULES §15: substrate's deviation from cdv1 prior). Glass uses the KWW + FDT-violation form; other substrates declare their own apparatus in follow-on schema cycles per RULES §10 (inherit substrate vocabulary).

chit.description: cdv1 leading-order (Tc - T for glass; similar for other substrates).

q_EA.description: v0.4 optional (glass). Edwards-Anderson plateau height in [0, 1].

tau_alpha.description: v0.4 optional (glass). Alpha-relaxation timescale in the bundle's tau (lag) units.

beta_KWW.description: v0.4 optional (glass). KWW stretching exponent in (0, 1].

tau_beta.description: v0.4 optional (glass). Beta-relaxation (cage-rattling) timescale in the bundle's tau (lag) units.

X.description: v0.4 optional (glass). FDT-violation ratio (= T / T_eff); X=1 is quasi-equilibrium aging, X<<1 is frozen aging.

T.description: v0.4 optional. Operating-point temperature -- typically read from observable.metadata.operating_point_T; carried here too when the fit uses it explicitly.

predicted_locus.description: Analytical locus at fitted (chit, gamma_AB), interpolated at the observable's tau values. One row per observable.data row.

model.description: Which forward model produced the predictions. v0.2 curator path: 'gfdr_analytical' (from conformer.compute.gfdr_model.generate_locus).

audit_delta.description: Per-row + aggregate residuals between observable.data and predicted_locus.rows; plus scale-solver-derived regime + gamut readings of the fitted canonical state.

locus_residual.description: MSE of empirical (C, chi) against predicted (C_predicted, chi_predicted) across rows.

gamma_residual.description: Residual of fitted gamma_AB against empirical phase-locking r, when available.

per_row_residuals.description: Optional per-row (C_residual, chi_residual). Carries display detail; aggregate locus_residual is the load-bearing scalar.

regime_label.description: Five-bucket vertex regime at fitted chit. Source: mpa_scale_solver.regime_at when available, else conformer.compute.gfdr_model.vertex_regime.

in_gamut.description: Whether the fitted canonical state lies in the driver-profile's gamut. Null when the gamut check was not run (no driver profile available at fit time).

fit_diagnostics.description: v0.3 NEW. Raw confidence signals from the fitting path. residual_final + regime_confidence + predictor_gap in their natural scales (path-conditional). Source field indicates which path produced them. Null only for legacy bundles.

diagnostic_percentiles.description: v0.3 NEW. Per-field percentile of this fit within the substrate's known-good baseline distribution. Range [0, 1]. 0 = better than any baseline fit on that field; 1 = worse than any baseline fit. Null when no baseline exists yet for this substrate (new substrate; falls back to raw fit_diagnostics inspection).

cross_path_disagreement.description: v0.3 NEW. |chit_two_stage_inversion - chit_lens_solver_prior| in chit units. Independent-paths agreement is a calibration-free per-cell signal. Null when only one path ran (rare: leading-order fallback).

method.description: How fitted_params was produced. 'leading_order_substrate_rule' = curator-path substrate-class rule (v0.1 carry-over for cells without a usable observable); 'two_stage_locus_fit' = analytical + ensemble refine over chit (gamma_AB initial default); 'two_stage_with_gamma_fit' = + gamma_AB grid against phase-locking r.

observable_used.description: Per-axis description of which observable each fitted parameter consumed. Carries inversion.py's chit_observable + gamma_observable labels.

inversion_provenance.description: Optional. mpa-scale-solver v1 Provenance stamp from apply_translation_wrapped / forward_sweep_invert_wrapped when the curator runs the scale-solver validation pass. Mirrors mpa_scale_solver.provenance.Provenance shape.

inversion_validation.description: Optional. mpa-scale-solver v1 ValidationReport stamp. Mirrors mpa_scale_solver.validation.ValidationReport shape.
